_about: The art registry (s19-artreg; how it works: docs/design-language/art-registry.md). One entry per piece by a stable id: its current file per state or variant, version, status, source, what it replaced, its measurements (each with where it came from). Seeded by build/tools/art/registry.mjs --seed from what the pages really load (build/reports/art-use.json); the cutter adds lines with registry.mjs add; never typed by hand. migrated: the games whose code asks by id (Sprint 20 on); for those, the contract rules fail instead of warn.
